comment: FAD-dependent halogenase responsible for bromination of W1 of darobactin A, yielding bromo-darobactin. Represents a new class of flavin-dependent halogenases with a novel fold, co-purified with FAD.

changelog.comment: Replaced retired UniProt ID with UniParc ID.

reactions.description: Bromination of C-8 of W1 of darobactin A, yielding bromodarobactin A.
Bromination of darobactin A at the C-8 position of W1, validated by in vitro assay with purified DarHPse, NaBr, FAD, and flavin reductase.
